Visual reviews and certification evidence use the centralized external data directory outside Git to protect repository hygiene.
Windows Sandbox is unavailable on the current Windows 11 Home host; Phase 16 clean-install certification was completed successfully using an isolated Windows 11 Pro VirtualBox VM.

Cross-platform desktop certification is now a mandatory POST-OCR gate (explicit user authority, 2026-09-17). Windows Stage 1 remains certified (30/30 invariants, historical). Arch Linux, Ubuntu LTS, and macOS remain NOT_STARTED and must be certified after OCR implementation and verification, before final release certification.

Real-engine smoke testing is hardware-bound: Unlimited-OCR upstream documents NVIDIA GPU/CUDA inference only and this host has no CUDA device, so P17 real-engine verification for English is BLOCKED BY CURRENT HARDWARE. The adapter, runtime, and contract layers are mock-tested and pass.

PP-OCRv5 real-engine smoke testing on this host is BLOCKED BY CURRENT RUNTIME: paddlepaddle 3.3.1 fails inside its PIR/oneDNN executor (ConvertPirAttribute2RuntimeAttribute not support [pir::ArrayAttribute<pir::DoubleAttribute>]) on this CPU, reproducibly, after the official PP-OCRv5_server_det and arabic_PP-OCRv5_mobile_rec models downloaded successfully. The failure is surfaced as a structured OCR_FAILED result.

Staged-update integrity verification detects post-staging corruption using hashes recorded at staging time; upstream publishes no independent release checksums for these engines, so this is not a supply-chain attestation.

P17-T002 benchmark material (corpus images, real ground truth, run output, fonts) lives only under READ_WATCH_DATA_ROOT/ocr/benchmark/ and is never committed; Git carries schema, algorithms, tests, documentation, and a 14-sample authored synthetic starter corpus in text form.

The synthetic starter corpus proves plumbing only. It is not representative of real books and is not sufficient for final accuracy acceptance; no engine has been benchmarked yet (P17-T004 outstanding).

The mandatory Urdu Nastaliq specialist qandeelasim13/urdu-ocr-trocr-si26 is declared and provenance-verified but NOT_INTEGRATED in this build, so Urdu recognition cannot be reported as complete. PP-OCRv5 alone is explicitly not a complete Urdu result.

The specialist's project repository declares no licence file and its training data includes CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 material; weight and dataset terms must be reviewed before any redistribution or commercial use.
Producing a benchmark image from a PDF page is not automated: the importer ingests an already-selected page/region/line image. No image or cropping library was added to the repository.
